newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sodra says no pulp price increase from Feb 1.
newsitem.headline: Sodra says no pulp price increase from Feb 1.

text.p: Swedish forestry cooperative Sodra's pulp division said on Tuesday it could not push through a planned increase on long-fibre pulp prices to $610 from $560 a tonne from February 1.
"We have not been able to raise the price. There are too few who have followed through with such an increase," head of Sodra Cell marketing Hans Burmeister told Reuters.

Another industry source also said the price increase failed to go through but said prices were steady around $560 per tonne. The source also said increased order intake of fine paper had supported prices at these levels.
Few market players had expected pulp prices to rise with several saying recently falls were more likely.
